Features

Farm management module features

Vertical logic built for real farming operations.

🗺️

Hierarchical locations

4-level hierarchy: Farm → Sector → Unit → House. Each level maps to analytic accounts, with workers and costs per location.

🌾

Crop management

Track varieties, planting dates, growth stages and expected yields — with crop rotation planning across seasons.

📋

Agricultural work orders

Orders for planting, irrigation, fertilising, spraying and harvesting, tracking labour hours, materials and equipment.

🚜

Harvest & inventory

Stock wizards auto-create warehouse receipts on harvest; lot tracking from field to storage to sale.

💰

Cost analytics

Real P&L per farm, crop and season, tracking seeds, fertiliser, water, labour and equipment.

👷

Worker payroll

Assign workers to locations, track attendance via work orders and auto-calculate daily, task-based or seasonal wages.
